triage.summary: Olivia Brown of Brown Bakery asks whether Alex can automate its cake order form so orders go into a Google Sheet, and what it would cost.

task.title: Clarify the order form requirements
task.description: Reply to Olivia Brown at Brown Bakery about automating its cake order form to send orders to a Google Sheet. Ask for the form platform and any relevant workflow details so you can estimate the cost.

reply.body:

Thanks for reaching out. I can look into this and put together an estimate. What platform is your cake order form on, and are there any specific details or workflows you’d like included in the Google Sheet?

Alex
